reader.requirement: At --std 85 (the 1989 amendment) the compiler must accept FUNCTION INTEGER ( argument-1 ) with exactly one argument (identifier, literal or arithmetic expression, A.2.2) and refuse every other shape: no FUNCTION word, no parentheses, zero or two arguments, and the 2002 argument forms (empty list, OMITTED, boolean, ALL on a fixed-arity function, REPOSITORY keyword omission).

edition-consulted.switches: the D8 window (sig.IntroducedIn 85 > DialectLevel; RemovedIn): INTEGER is available at 85
NumericFunctionIdentifierOperand2002: an integer function outside an arithmetic expression refused at 85

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for the format: the one-argument shape and the floor values are the same at 2023 (legal.cob prints identical lines at --std 2023, two_args_comma.cob is refused identically); the 2002 argument forms and the keyword omission differ.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses cover two arguments and the floor values of identifiers; not exercised: the no-parentheses and empty-list forms, expression, literal, nested, scaled and 18-digit arguments, the 2002 argument forms at 85.

probes.expected: the greatest integer <= argument-1 (A.2.15.4 RV1) for each

probes.printed: BIG and BIGF (18-digit extremes, negative) as above
error COBOL1504: FUNCTION INTEGER takes 1 argument(s); 2 given
error COBOL1504 (0 given) and COBOL0900: an empty function argument list '( )' requires COBOL-2002

probes.expected: refused: the word FUNCTION is required at 85

probes.printed: error COBOL0900: the REPOSITORY FUNCTION entry requires COBOL-2002; and COBOL1639 'INTEGER(A)' not defined
error COBOL1627: argument-1 is of class alphanumeric
error COBOL0900: the boolean literal requires COBOL-2002; COBOL1627
error COBOL1544: OMITTED shall not be specified as an intrinsic-function argument
error COBOL1645: the ALL subscript is permitted only when the function's definition permits an argument to be repeated

reader.notes: The grammar makes the argument list optional for every function; the catalog row's fixed arity 1..1 is what refuses the no-parentheses and empty forms, and VersionConformancePass adds the 2002 empty-list refusal. Every value matches A.2.15.4 RV1.

refuter.evidence: Read §1989:A.2.15 (INTEGER: one class-numeric argument, type integer), §1985:IV.4.3.8.3.3 SR1/SR2/SR4 (function-identifier, as amended in place) and §1985:VI.6.2.2 (operators spaced). Probes at --std 85 under refute-1985-09/c5: DISPLAY / MOVE / ADD / PERFORM ... TIMES with FUNCTION INTEGER as the identifier operand (display_int, move_int, add_int, perform_times) -> COBOL0900 (integer function only in an arithmetic expression); IF FUNCTION INTEGER(A) = -2 and IF FUNCTION INTEGER (- A) > 0 (if_int) -> 'EQ','POS'; (A -1) and (A +1), a space-separated signed literal (signed_lit_second, signed_lit_plus) -> COBOL1504 two arguments, identically at 2023; numeric-edited argument (edited_arg) and ref-modified argument (refmod_arg) -> COBOL1627; index-name argument (index_arg) -> COBOL1637; FUNCTION INTEGER(A) (1:1) (refmod_fn) -> COBOL1629. cite.py: OK §1989:A.2.15.3 AR1; OK §1985:IV.4.3.8.3.3 SR4; OK §1985:IV.4.3.8.3.3 SR2; OK §1985:VI.6.2.2.
